edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build; nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build; nothing is released

  Scenario: AC7 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the rwb-integration contract mock does not answer the buyer file request of lot "LOT-2026-000042" within the activity timeout
    When the data transfer activity runs
    Then the activity is retried under the retry policy of the activity
    Then when the retries are exhausted the transfer is not recorded and the lot status is unchanged

  Scenario: AC8 A consumed call fails
    Given the rwb-payment contract mock returns an error for the buyer remittance of lot "LOT-2026-000042"
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "SETTLEMENT_PENDING" for "RC-2026-000842"
    When the settlement step runs
    Then no transfer is recorded and the lot status is unchanged
    Then the case does not move to SETTLED

  Scenario: AC9 A disallowed status change is refused
    Given the lot "LOT-2026-000042" has the status TRANSFERRED
    When a status change the model does not allow is requested for the lot
    Then the status change is refused and the lot status is unchanged
    Then no event is published
